summary: Set hub_storage_backend=azure with hub_azure_account_key, hub_azure_account_name and hub_azure_container (container must exist); extra options go in hub_azure_extra_settings.
questions: How do I use Azure Blob Storage for automation hub?
Azure storage variables for containerized hub

answer_card.title: Hub on Azure Blob Storage
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
hub_storage_backend=azure
hub_azure_account_key=<account_key>
hub_azure_account_name=<account_name>
hub_azure_container=<container_name>
```
The container must exist before installing.
